streak.description: A GitHub-style calendar grid of done days for a habit streak.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: The bound done days: an array of YYYY-MM-DD strings.

attributes.name: weeks
attributes.description: How many weeks to show, clamped to 4 through 26.

ring.description: A hand-rolled SVG progress ring for a single value against a max.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: The bound value: a number, or an object with value and optional max fields.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current value. Wins over the binding.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: The ring's maximum. Wins over the binding.

habits.description: A compact grid of habits by day, checked off per day.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: The bound week: an object with an optional days array and a rows array of habits.

log.description: A minimal table of dated log entries with an optional numeric value.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: The bound entries: an array of objects with date, text, and an optional numeric value.
